To: @renee.whitlock
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: Football rundown for Monday admin meeting

[DRAFT — not sent yet. I'll look it over between 2nd and 3rd period.]

Here's the football rundown for Monday's admin meeting.

GAME (Friday final)
Vulcan Ridge 31, Brookhollow 14. That locks up second in the region. Deshawn Pettaway had 3 sacks and 7 tackles, and Tavion Hurst ran for 188 yards and 2 touchdowns. The kids voted Deshawn defensive player of the week in the locker room before the coaches had even met. Tavion took it long in the third quarter, and our line pushed them five yards back on that whole drive — best I've seen them block all year. Defense held them to 46 yards rushing in the second half.

PLAYOFFS
We host Clanton Valley in the first round, Friday Nov 13, 7pm at Ridge Field. Presale starts Tuesday, and the gate crew and chain crew still need confirming by Wednesday. Dr. Pruitt should know we have a HOME playoff game — I'd like folks in the stands.

GRADES
Nine week grade check is in. All 52 kids on the roster are eligible, nobody's on the list. That's Tonya Greer's study hall (Tuesdays and Thursdays) doing the work. She deserves the credit, not me.

BOOSTERS
Boston butt sale final count: 208 butts sold, $6,240 raised against a $4,500 goal. That money goes toward the new sideline headsets. Big thanks to Hargrove's Meat Market for doing the smoking at cost. Gene's got a sign-up sheet going out tomorrow — we need 6 more on concessions for the playoff game.

TRANSPORTATION
If we win and go on the road, I'll get the bus requests to you five days out like you asked.

Two other quick notes: the main gym floor gets refinished Nov 16-20, so my PE classes are in the aux gym or outside that week. And the faculty meeting moved to Wednesday 3:30 in the library for the board report.
